decision.rationale: H9 and H10 failed to produce a valid control endpoint or any treatment outcome, so the robust-loss question remains prospectively untested. H10 exposed a control-plane observability defect rather than a method effect. The smallest causal continuation is one new clean H11 with the exact H10 scientific variable, source, fixed sample and gates, but only after a separately audited process-provenance and terminalization gate. CAL-EXT-001 is severe but observational, and Path-1 remains incomplete and ineligible.
control_plane_gate: H11 must preserve full forbidden-process provenance: PID,parent PID,creation time,executable,command line and command-line SHA256.
A protocol abort from either control or treatment must atomically terminalize the active-window sentinel.

No parent or delegated shell,hash,file-read,process-list,project or evaluation command may run while either H11 trainer is active; exact locked watchers and unchanged Path-1 are the only project processes.
Offline tests must prove exact evaluator/Slumbot/mirror detection,locked lifecycle/Path-1 non-triggering,full provenance capture and control-arm terminal recovery.
Immutable H11 preregistration,implementation audit,design lock,preflight and canonical rearm must all pass before launch.
scientific_lock: Use fresh run directories and the exact canonical H8 endpoint for both arms;never use H9/H10 partial checkpoints.
Use fixed20M actual hands per arm,control-first order,beta1.0 and every H10 statistical gate unchanged.
Do not reuse H10 first60 as H11 control throughput baseline.
